commits.summary: fix(flush): run the flush model with no tools: tools=[] (CLI --tools "") and strict_mcp_config=True; allowed_tools=[] and max_turns=2 unchanged. Cause, stated in the message: allowed_tools=[] only sets which tools skip the approval prompt; it does not limit the tool set. The bundled CLI offered every built-in tool plus 162 MCP tools. In all 3 failed runs (10-10 11:20 b9f3babc, 10-12 07:31 e4df5d4a, 10-12 15:36 ac0368ab) the model acted on requests inside the pasted conversation (Read a handoff, Bash ps/tail on memsearch, ToolSearch then a Google Drive MCP search), used both turns on tool calls, and hit max_turns_reached {maxTurns 2, turnCount 3}. Adds scripts/test_flush_tools_disabled.py. The suggested 'keep text received before the error' fix was rejected on purpose: in these runs that text was tool narration ('I'm starting Batch 96 now. Let me read the handoff'), not a summary. max_turns was not raised: with no tools one turn is enough, and raising it would let the model run more tool calls.
